title: Lightly Smoked Filipino Clams Menudo
description: A spicy and juicy Filipino dish featuring clams, perfect for curing hangovers, this vegan-friendly menudo is a unique twist on traditional recipes, with a smoky flavor from cold smoking, and made with clams for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Rinse the clams under cold water and scrub the shells to remove any dirt or debris.
In a large pot, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, and ginger until the onion is translucent.
Add the smoked paprika and cayenne pepper to the pot and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the clams to the pot, covering with a lid.
Simmer the menudo for 10 minutes or until the clams are open and the sauce has thickened.
Season the menudo with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the menudo hot, garnished with chopped green onions or scallions if desired.
